subject: English
passage: Art historians recognize over thirty different styles of Byzantine mosaics. One variety, the imperial portrait mosaic, ______ both large-scale ceremonial works that decorated palace walls and smaller devotional pieces created for private chapels.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. This verb needs to function as the main verb in the sentence, with the subject "one variety," so it needs to be conjugated. This choice gives us the singular present tense "features," which is the only conjugated form of the verb among the choices.
